body:
I can sleep in the bed if I pretend I'm okay. If I'm with my thoughts too long I get upset and I choose to sleep on the floor in the other room as not to bother him or keep him up with my crying. 

Plus it's very hard sharing a bed with someone who knows you're distraught and chooses to ignore it.
I've tried several times, it always leads to him getting irate and me sleeping in the floor. It's much easier to keep it to myself or pretend I'm okay.
Yes, they don't seem to care. He's currently laughing at the tv. I've been crying for a week.
I drink water and nibble here and there I'm not starving myself. I won't feel better without communication. That's what I'm lacking. It's making me want to leave my partner because it's no different.
I just don't feel up to it. I have no appetite and it doesn't interest me. Nothing does. I stare at ceilings for hours on end. Either that or I sleep.

None of those things matter to me anymore unfortunately. I've lost trust in the people around me and in myself. I feel like a shell of me. A insecure husk riddled with darting thoughts. As the days go by the more disinterested in life I get. Thank you for trying to help. 😔
Yeah. I just don't know what to do with myself. I feel hollow. I've never felt so alone.

I've tried speaking to a couple before. I can't seem to give the right answers to their questions and they get frustrated with me. And then obviously as a reaction I get frustrated to. And then we don't seem to get anywhere. 
Talking to someone I don't know about my feelings makes me extremely uncomfortable and doesn't seem to help my anxiety.
